purpose: Extend the user's selected textured cave design with less rectangular terrain silhouettes.
method: Built-in image generation edit of the supplied scene, saved as a separate sibling.
shapeAndEdgePrecision: Macro silhouette study using slopes, clipped rock shoulders and asymmetric banks. Not a final DualGrid mask atlas, collision shape or accepted tile-edge contract.
keep: The selected richer warm-brown and cool-slate rock treatment, dark ink cracks and thin ochre rim.
One original cyan protagonist with its established size, face and outfit.
Side-view framing, restrained plants, orange mushrooms, ore patches, waterfall and pool.
change: Long rectangular platforms become short resting ledges connected by unequal slopes.
Vertical step faces become diagonal broken rock shoulders and supported outcrops.
The rectangular pool becomes an asymmetric shallow basin with sloped rocky banks.
The ceiling and foreground form varied natural masses rather than repeated box shapes.
implementationIntent: Retain local repeatable rock patterns and a limited edge vocabulary. Later production should map slope segments to existing game shapes; concept curves do not imply new collision or liquid systems.
